name: qlrisk_frtb_sa_capital
title: FRTB Standardised Approach capital
description: FRTB SA market-risk capital (MAR21-23) for a book: sensitivities-based method (GIRR, CSR, equity, commodity, FX delta, vega and curvature under the low / medium / high correlation scenarios), default risk charge (non-securitisation) and the residual risk add-on, with breakdowns by component and bucket. Map names to buckets (credit_buckets {'ACME': 4}, equity_buckets {'SPX': 12}), ratings for DRC ({'ACME': 'BBB'}) and vol surfaces to underlyings ({'eq_vol': 'SPX'}); unmapped factors are reported. mode='sbm_from_sensitivities' aggregates FRTB sensitivities you supply; mode='drc_from_positions' charges DRC on positions you supply.
